pages.title: One Canvas
pages.text: All discovered specializations share one canvas. Right-click a node to expand or collapse its branch. Left-click to read its details; hold left-click to buy a rank. Middle-click toggles an unlocked node.$(br2)Drag empty space to pan. Scroll to zoom. At distant zoom, nodes keep a minimum readable size and stay apart.

pages.title: Find Your Skills
pages.text: Type a discovered skill in Search and press Enter to find it. Press $(k:mastery.focus_node) to center the selected node. Reset returns toward the roots.$(br2)Collapse closes branches. Invested opens developed branches. Details toggles the information panel. Spells opens your assignments.

pages.title: Operator Editing
pages.text: Operators can run /mastery edit_mode true to edit world definitions. While editing, this guide reveals the Operator Workshop with step-by-step documentation for skills, elemental damage, combat scripts, keywords, and production bonuses.$(br2)/mastery edit_mode false returns to the player view.

pages.title: Export Your Data
pages.text: Operators can run /mastery export to save the accepted Mastery definitions as a datapack ZIP in their client's config/exports folder.$(br2)The archive combines loaded definitions and accepted editor changes, including disabled resources. Its filename uses local time and preserves earlier exports. Exporting does not reload the server.

pages.title: Skill Book Gates
pages.text: Require Skill Book gates a node and its children behind a consumable book. Copy book command gives you the matching book command.$(br2)The token can be edited to share one book across branches. Removing the gate keeps other prerequisites in place.
